caption: This drawing features a group of human figures clustered on the right side, with some dressed in red and blue garments adorned with white trim and pointed hats. There is a central figure with a crown of thorns and a body marked with red lines, wearing a simple white cloth around the waist and holding a large wooden cross. Surrounding this figure are several individuals, some with their hands extended toward him. In the background on the left, there is a depiction of a hilly or mountainous landscape in shades of green, red, and brown, with small black tree-like shapes scattered along the slopes. The sky above the mountain area is shaded with muted blue and gray tones. The composition is horizontally oriented, with the larger group of figures and the cross dominating the right half, while the landscape fills the left half of the scene.
title: Station of the Cross No. 10: "Jesus is Stripped of His Garments"
